description: Apply one spatial transformation (flip, rotate, crop, pad, resize, or translate) to a raster image or .mcpx source. Returns PNG bytes and/or the editable source via explicit output paths or embedded artifacts; no force, mkdir, or in-place writes.

inputPath.description: Raster image or .mcpx path to transform.

outputMcpxPath.description: Explicit .mcpx output path. When omitted, the .mcpx text is embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

outputPngPath.description: Explicit PNG output path. When omitted, the PNG bytes are embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

resizeMode.description: Resize sampling: nearest, box, or pixel-aware.

selection.description: Scope operations to a selection expression: all, rect:x,y,w,h, region:id, alpha[:layer], color[:layer]:r,g,b,a, connected[:layer]:x,y, or a JSON expression object with op union|intersect|subtract|invert and operands [...]; cannot be combined with geometry operations (ARGUMENT_CONFLICT).

name: transform_asset
